name: Leviafan: Gruz
source:
Following the events of The Last Day of the Decade, a band of smugglers carries a chest through the underground tunnels beneath the city of Kroistham in this action-adventure game rich with captivating dialogues and story, choices that matter and optional dungeons to explore.

What if world-changing stories begin from nothing? For example, from a gang of smugglers carrying a valuable cargo through the underground tunnels of an ancient city… A sealed box containing something meaningful, something that can change the fate of an entire country and its people.

It does not matter where this story starts. What matters is that you are a part of it, and the chest bearing the precious cargo is on a train seat right beside you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/411130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
继“十年的最后一天”事件之后，在这款动作冒险游戏中，一伙走私者带着箱子穿过克罗伊瑟姆市地下的地下隧道，游戏中充满了引人入胜的对话和故事、重要的选择以及可供探索的可选地下城。

如果改变世界的故事从无到有怎么办？例如，一伙走私者携带着贵重货物穿过一座古城的地下隧道……一个密封的盒子，里面装着一些有意义的东西，一些可以改变整个国家及其人民命运的东西。

这个故事从哪里开始并不重要。重要的是你是其中的一部分，而装有贵重货物的箱子就在你旁边的火车座位上。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/411130/]Steam[/url]]
